in_marathi.name: Vishwa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे All, Universe, Whole
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishwa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishwa means 'All' or 'Universal' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is a name that represents the vastness and totality of the universe and all that exists within it. It is a name that embodies wisdom, knowledge, and truth.
